claims.statement: Management expects to see more store openings in Uttar Pradesh compared to Odisha due to existing inventory and acquired locations.
claims.quote: Possible to do both states, but we'll see more stores in UP for obvious reasons. We have inventory there. We have acquired some locations there. So, you'll see that coming.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management aims to achieve break-even at the PAT level for DMart Ready.
claims.quote: in general, our view is that at the P&L level, PAT, we have to break even at that level, not EBITDA. So, all attempts are being made to grow at a reasonable level, and at the same time, try and be as close to break-even as possible.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The company operates around 400 plus stores currently out of a conservative total country opportunity of approximately 2,200 stores.
facts.quote: So, 2,200 is approximately the number of stores, out of which 400 something is what we already have. So, 1,800 approximately is the opportunity.

facts.statement: The pharmacy initiative currently has seven pharmacy stores operational.
facts.quote: We have started. We have seven pharmacy stores now operational and encouraging results.

facts.statement: Transportation costs for DMart Ready have increased due to a significant rise in home delivery.
facts.quote: transportation costs have increased because home delivery has significantly increased.
